policy: Primary-source polling evidence may be staged for review when the publisher supplies sufficient methodology and the reported toplines can be reconciled. Staging never implies human acceptance or model eligibility.

records.method: online panel; quotas for age, gender, location, education and 2025 federal vote; rim weighted; undecided leaner then unresolved excluded
records.correctionHistory: The AFR initially displayed conflicting 53-47 and 57-43 Coalition-Labor two-party figures. Subsequent reporting records that RedBridge/Accent clarified the correct respondent-allocated result as 57-43.
records.reviewNotes: Primary publisher confirms fieldwork, sample, effective sample, weighting, undecided treatment and respondent-allocated preference method. Primary vote toplines are consistently reported as Coalition 30, Labor 23, One Nation 22, Greens 14, Others 11. Before model eligibility, review sample-family independence from the June large-sample/MRP-related evidence and the leadership-regime timing.
